= = = ===========================================
 Appearance :
 For the Appellant/s : Mr.Akash Anand
 For the Respondent/s : Mr.Dr.K.N.Singh (A.S.G.)

======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Alok Kumar Pandey
 Oral Order

3 05-12-2025 Heard both sides.
2. Admit.
3. Call for the trial court records in connection with Special Case No. 27 of 2011 arising out of R.C.
No. 3/A/2006 from the Court of learned Special Judge, C.B.I., Ist, Patna.
4.

This appeal has been filed against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 29.08.2025 passed by learned Special Judge C.B.I. Ist, Patna in connection with Spl. Case No. 27 of 2011, R.C. 3/A/06

whereby and whereunder appellant has been convicted for the offences under Section 120/B read with Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC, Section 13(2) read with Section 13(1)(D)
of the P.C. Act.
The appellant has been sentenced to undergo S.I. for one year each along with Patna High Court CR.

APP (SJ) No.4048 of 2025(3) dt.05-12-2025 fine of Rs. 5,000/- each under Sections 120(B) r/w 420, 467, 468 of the I.P.C. and Section 13(2) read with Section 13(1)(D) of the P.C. Act and in default of payment of fine appellant shall undergo simple imprisonment of two months.

The appellant has further been sentenced to undergo S.I. for six months along with fine of Rs. 2,500/-

sentences.text:
5. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that this appeal has been filed within time and maximum sentence of two years has been imposed and the appellant has got privilege under Section 389(3) of the Cr.P.C. thereby granting provisional bail and he is still on provisional bail and accordingly, a prayer has been made to confirm the said provisional bail.
6.
Learned A.P.P. has no objection to the prayer for confirmation of provisional bail.

7. Considering the above submissions, the provisional bail granted to the appellant is hereby confirmed on the same bail bond taken by the convicting trial court and the appellant will be treated as on bail during the pendency of this appeal.
8. Sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended and realization of fine shall also remain stayed during the Patna High Court CR.
APP (SJ) No.4048 of 2025(3) dt.05-12-2025 pendency of this appeal.

9. At this stage, learned A.P.P. for the State submits that from perusal of impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 29.08.2025 it appears that appellant has been acquitted from charges under Section 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC but while hearing on the point of sentence

,
appellant has been sentenced to undergo S.I. for one year along with fine of Rs. 5,000/- each under Sections 120(B) r/w 420, 467, 468 of the I.P.C. and Section 13(2) read with Section 13(1)(D) of the P.C. Act and to undergo S.I. for six months along with fine of Rs. 2,500/- under section 120(B) read with Section 471 I.P.C.
10.

In the aforesaid circumstance, let certified copy of impugned judgment and order of sentence passed by the court of learned Special Judge C.B.I. Ist, Patna in connection with Special Case No. 27 of 2011 arising out of R.C. No. 3/A/2006 be sent to the concerned court for its verification regarding the aforesaid discrepancy and after verification, if requires, necessary correction be made before sending the trial courts records.
The concerned court shall transmit the certified copy of the impugned judgment and order of sentence to this court within two weeks from the date of its receipt.
11. Let this order be communicated to learned Patna High Court CR.

APP (SJ) No.4048 of 2025(3)
dt.05-12-2025 Principal District and Sessions Judge, Patna for the needful.
